entities.name: Xyrun-Jed
entities.description: The last emperor of the loxodon on Arcavios, who hid his city Zantafar rather than see it conquered.

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: The famed lost city of the loxodon.

entities.name: Loxodon
entities.description: Elephant-like people of Arcavios dispersed across the Vastlands.

entities.name: Canticle of Jed
entities.description: Prayer and piece of loxodon culture attributed to Xyrun-Jed.

events.summary: Zantafar falls or is hidden in the last emperor's time, dispersing the loxodon across the Vastlands.
events.quote: Xyrun-Jed’s actions resulted in the dispersion of the loxodon across the Vastlands.

relations.quote: He was the last emperor of the loxodon.
